summary: Migrating from Terraform Community Edition adapts usage rather than the collection; afterwards update AAP credentials, EE and job templates. cloud.terraform supports only the CLI-driven workflow in HCP Terraform. Prerequisites: Terraform 1.11 or later, tf-migrate CLI, and a workspace not set to auto-apply.
questions: What Terraform version is needed to migrate from community edition?
Does cloud.terraform support VCS-driven workflows in HCP Terraform?
What must I update in AAP after migrating from Terraform Community Edition?
